name: Serkify Clean Buddy
author: serkifybuddy

sections.description:
Serkify Clean Buddy provides a centralized admin workspace for site inspection, diagnostic tracking, and database cleanup. It helps site administrators gain full visibility into their backend to troubleshoot fatal errors, remove orphaned data, and resolve performance bottlenecks without leaving the dashboard.

Instead of guessing what is causing site crashes or taking up database space, Serkify Clean Buddy lets you explore error logs, preview changes, and selectively clean your site data from a single interface. It is useful for debugging 500 Internal Server Errors, auditing site health, and managing bloated databases.

Core Features:

*Fatal Error & Log Explorer: Access and parse server error logs directly from the dashboard to identify PHP fatal errors, memory exhaustion, database connection issues, and plugin conflicts without needing server access.

*Preview-First Cleanup Workflows: All cleanup actions include confirmation safeguards. Preview exactly what data will be modified or removed before executing any changes.

*Site Snapshots & Backups: Safely create backups of your database, uploads folder, settings, and general site data before making modifications. Built-in comparison tools allow you to compare site states before and after.

*Deep Diagnostic Explorers: Navigate and manage your site’s hidden architecture through dedicated explorers for media, database tables, options, and cron events.

*Plugin Footprint Tracker: Identify and remove orphaned database entries, options, and leftover configurations left behind by previously uninstalled plugins.

*Configuration Health Check: Audit your site’s current configuration health to ensure core files and settings are optimized.

*Duplicate Metadata Cleanup: Automatically scan for and safely remove duplicate or bloated metadata to reduce database size and improve query performance.

Privacy

The plugin stores its settings, snapshots, and operation history in the site’s WordPress database. Plugin-generated backup files are stored beneath the site’s WordPress uploads directory. Uninstall removes plugin-owned options, tables, transients, and plugin-created backup directories. This WordPress.org package does not send site data to an external service.

Source code

The distributed PHP, JavaScript, and CSS files are the human-readable source used by the plugin. They are not minified or generated from hidden source, and no compilation step is needed to review or modify them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the serkify-clean-buddy folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Serkify Clean Buddy.
  3. Open Serkify Clean Buddy in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a backup and preview an operation before running destructive cleanup.
sections.faq:
Are features locked behind a license?

No. This WordPress.org package has no licensing, trial, paid unlock, or restricted functional tabs.

Does the plugin delete data immediately?

Cleanup workflows provide previews and confirmations. Create a current backup and inspect the preview before running a destructive action.
